    Dimensions and endolengths in a finite Galois orbit of stable modules #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.FieldExtension.finite_galois_constituent_dimensions (k : Type u) [Field k] (F R : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra k F] [Ring R] [Algebra k R] [Module.Finite k R] [Module.Finite k F] [IsGalois k F] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)] [Finite k] (P : TwoTerm R) (S : FGModuleCat R) (hs : (TwoTerm.eulerWeight k P).IsStable S) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (B : Fin n → FGModuleCat (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)), 0 < n ∧ Nonempty (extendObj k F R S ≅ ⨁ B) ∧ (∀ (i : Fin n), (TwoTerm.eulerWeight F (extendTwoTerm k F R P)).IsStable (B i)) ∧ Function.Injective (CategoryTheory.toSkeleton ∘ B) ∧ (∀ (Y : FGModuleCat (ExtendedAlgebra k F R)), (TwoTerm.eulerWeight F (extendTwoTerm k F R P)).IsStable Y → ((∃ (f : S ⟶ restrictObj k F R Y), f ≠ 0) ↔ ∃ (i : Fin n), Nonempty (Y ≅ B i))) ∧ (∀ (i j : Fin n), ∃ (σ : Gal(F/k)) (v : restrictObj k F R (B i) ⟶ restrictObj k F R (B j)), IsGaloisHom k F R σ v ∧ Function.Bijective ⇑(ModuleCat.Hom.hom v.hom)) ∧ ∀ (i : Fin n), Module.finrank k ↑S.obj = n * Module.finrank F ↑(B i).obj ∧ homFinrank k S S = n * homFinrank F (B i) (B i) ∧ endolength k S = endolength F (B i)

    In the multiplicity-free orbit over a finite extension, the module dimension and endomorphism dimension of each constituent are obtained by dividing the corresponding ground dimensions by the size of the orbit. In particular endolength is preserved.
